subject: Total number of batches after a run

messages.author: dca17e072251f920
messages.subject: Total number of batches after a run
parts:
Hi!

I was wondering if there is a way to get the total number of batches released after a run is completed in order to use that number in further calculations (fixed costs of a batch). Each batch number does show up in the log after using log_() after batch(), but I can’t find a way to implement those in the calculations I made from get_mon_arrivals(). Therefore I was wondering if there is a function or workaround to get the total number of batches after a run? Dividing the total arrivals with the batch size won’t work since I am using clones, which are included in the batches but not in further calculations.

Thankyou in advance.

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] Total number of batches after a run
parts:
The easiest way is to add a global attribute for this:

batch(...) %>%
set_global("counter", 1, mod="+") %>%
etc.

Iñaki

On Sun, 27 Jun 2021 at 16:03, Richard Kuhlmeijer <r.kuhl...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> How can I get the global attribute after the run is completed? I have tried get_global(env, "counter") but that gives the following error: Error in UseMethod("get_global") : no applicable method for 'get_global' applied to an object of class "list"

1) You need to set mon=2 in the generator, so that attributes are
recorded (see ?add_generator).
2) Then, attributes are retrieved with get_mon_attributes().
